top_story.headline: Rep. Maria Elvira Salazar discloses 42 stock trades, most a September 24 sell-off
top_story.dek: Her October 7 periodic transaction report is dominated by partial sales in a UBS IRA, including a stake in SpaceX.
paragraphs: Rep. Maria Elvira Salazar (R-FL27) filed a periodic transaction report on October 7, 2026 listing 42 stock transactions: 33 sales and 9 purchases. 28 of the sales are dated September 24, 2026, mostly partial sales in her UBS IRA, spanning Boeing Company, Goldman Sachs Group, Inc., Microsoft Corporation, Meta Platforms, Inc., UnitedHealth Group Incorporated and Space Exploration Technologies Corp. (SPCX).

Purchases cluster earlier in September: Okta, Inc. and Snowflake Inc. on September 4, Corning Incorporated on September 8, Meta Platforms, Inc. on September 22 and Chevron Corporation on September 2. Each line is $1,001–$15,000 except a full Cisco Systems, Inc. sale and a Snowflake Inc. purchase, both $15,001–$50,000. Notification dates are October 1, 2026 for every line.

sections.headline: Rep. Maria Elvira Salazar reports 42 stock trades; Rep. Josh Gottheimer reports two sales
paragraphs: Two House periodic transaction reports were read in full: Rep. Maria Elvira Salazar’s filing lists 42 stock trades (33 sales, 9 purchases) across a UBS IRA and a UBS brokerage account, and Rep. Josh Gottheimer’s filing lists two sales. Five House candidate reports and four new Senate-side filings round out the window; no filing was left unread this edition (cap not hit). Filings already reported in earlier editions were dropped.

items: Rep. Maria Elvira Salazar filed one periodic transaction report on October 7, 2026 covering 28 partial or full sales dated September 24, 2026, plus other sales and purchases dated September 2–22. Every line is $1,001–$15,000 except two at $15,001–$50,000 (a full sale of Cisco Systems, Inc. in the brokerage account and a purchase of Snowflake Inc. in the IRA). Filing.

sections.headline: 696 Senate lobbying filings posted since October 7, led by 38 new registrations and a 10-client tariff batch from McLarty Inbound LLC
paragraphs: The Senate lobbying database posted 696 filings in the window: 484 third-quarter reports (plus 65 no-activity reports), 38 new registrations, 14 registration amendments, 25 terminations or termination amendments and the rest quarterly amendments. Registrations and amendments are tabulated below; quarterly reports are not itemized. Nothing in the window ties directly to another DC Record edition today. Of note, McLarty Inbound LLC filed registration amendments for 10 clients, nearly all listing trade, tariff and Section 232 issues.
